## Safety Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run check`, or I explained why a narrower gate is the correct evidence for this change.
- [ ] I did not add `.cognopticon/` state, daemon tokens, private paths, generated local workspace JSON, or private logs.
- [ ] Public demo data remains sanitized and rooted under `/demo/`.

- [ ] UI changes include mobile and desktop evidence or Playwright coverage.
